name: Aqua Mare

seo.title: Aqua Mare Galápagos Superyacht Cruise | James Wild & Co
seo.description: Aqua Mare by Aqua Expeditions: a 50 m superyacht for 16 guests, 7 cabins with an 80 sq m Owner's Suite, two naturalists. East and west Galápagos, 7 or 14 nights, every fare.

tagline: A 50-metre Italian superyacht for 16, and two naturalists for the islands.
answer: Aqua Mare is Aqua Expeditions' 50-metre superyacht in the Galápagos, built by CRN in Italy and refitted in 2021. She carries 16 guests in seven cabins, including an 80 sq m Owner's Suite, with 16 crew and two naturalist guides (eight guests to a guide). She sails seven-night east and west itineraries that join into 14 nights, and suits couples and families who want the islands on a private-feeling yacht.
facts: 7, including an 80 sq m (861 sq ft) Owner's Suite for up to 4
East or west, 7 nights; both, 14 nights
overview: Aqua Mare was built in 1998 by the Italian yard CRN, with interiors by François Zuretti. Aqua Expeditions' Birgit Galli Zugaro led her 2021 refit, which kept the walnut-panelled interiors and added two cabins. Aqua says she has some 30% more indoor volume than most yachts her size.

Her seven cabins run from 16 sq m to the 80 sq m Owner's Suite on the main deck, the largest of its kind in the islands, per Aqua. The upper deck has a panoramic lounge in Carrara marble and an all-weather outdoor dining deck; the sun deck a barbecue, a six-person jacuzzi and sunbeds; the lower deck the Beach Club, a lounge at the waterline from which the twice-daily excursions leave. She carries eight double kayaks and two paddleboards.

Where a category shows no fare it is sold out or not sold on that date. Aqua's Early Bird, returning-guest and loyalty savings are applied when booking, so the fare you pay can be lower; we confirm it with Aqua before you commit. Galápagos National Park entrance and transit card fees and flights to the islands are not in Aqua's fares.

faqs: How much does Aqua Mare cost?
Aqua lists seven nights from about US$11,900 per person in a Category V cabin to about US$32,000 and up in the Owner's Suite, by date. Every departure is in the table on this page.
Which Galápagos islands does Aqua Mare visit?

The east route takes in Genovesa, Santiago, Bartolomé, Santa Cruz, Española, Santa Fé and South Plaza; the west route Floreana, Isabela, Fernandina, Santiago, Rábida and North Seymour. Fourteen nights does both.
How many guests are on Aqua Mare?
Sixteen, in seven cabins, with two naturalist guides: eight guests to a guide.
Yes. Aqua offers her as a private charter on her 7 and 14 night routes or one made for you; ask us.
Is it a good Galápagos yacht for families?
Yes for families who want a whole small ship: the Owner's Suite takes four. Ask us about children's ages.
Flights to the islands and the national park fees.
